summary: Practise connected shelter and livelihoods assessments, market analysis and recovery planning. Explore the course and build field-ready outputs.
lede: Shelter and livelihoods recovery planning connects housing support with household income, local markets and access to services. For recovery coordinators, shelter and livelihoods officers, and programme managers, this training offers a practical approach to assessing needs and planning coordinated assistance using the Sphere Handbook. You will practise synthesizing assessment data, analysing markets and supply chains, comparing assistance and targeting options, and developing safer-shelter plans and monitoring reports.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for humanitarian and recovery practitioners who assess shelter and livelihood needs, coordinate assistance, advise on recovery choices or monitor implementation with affected communities and partner agencies.
prerequisites: Relevant experience in humanitarian response, shelter, livelihoods, cash and markets, recovery coordination or programme monitoring is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Exercises use assessment and partner information in spreadsheet-based templates; familiarity with field reporting is useful.
